dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY with .INC copybooks, no EXEC SQL/CICS
evidence: no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) system - inpatient (入院) accounting calculation subprogram for workers' compensation (労災) inpatient billing
purpose.summary: This is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system that performs inpatient (入院) accounting calculations for workers' compensation (労災) claims. It processes inpatient treatment records, applies various surcharges and deductions (加算/減算) based on Japanese medical fee schedule rules, and computes billing amounts. The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2003-2009 covering multiple Japanese medical fee revisions.

notable_features: 226 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
OCCURS clauses with 31 elements (days in a month)
Extensive Japanese-language comments in EUC-JP encoding (decoded as latin-1)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Fixed-format source with some lines over 72 chars
verdict.notes: Source file is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but was decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comments and string literals. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used widely in Japanese medical clinics. Revision history spans 2003-2009 with multiple named developers (NACL team). The 15 lines over 72 chars are minor and typical for this codebase.
